basis: Identical to R14 release1b_hook_manifest.json except defect-16 reclassification note
defect_16_reclassification: Defect-16 is now IMPL-MD (was incorrectly IMPL in R14). The alias_intercept hook shares the auth route with PocketBase core; the post-removal expected status cannot be determined without operator-provided interceptor baseline. HOOK_EXPECTED_REMOVED_STATUS[alias_intercept] remains UNRESOLVED__NEEDS_EXTERNAL.

onboarding.description: Patient onboarding hook. Handles antenatal phase enrollment and routing.
onboarding.removal_status_rationale: Route is hook-exclusive; disappears when hook is removed

push_broadcast.description: Push notification broadcast hook. Authorized exclusion E6: OTP endpoint reachability (corrected from R14 push-broadcast meaning).

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp integration hook. Authorized exclusion E8: WARN-log observability (corrected from R14 WhatsApp meaning).

alias_intercept.description: Alias account intercept hook. Intercepts auth-with-password for alias accounts and returns 400.
alias_intercept.removal_status_rationale: UNRESOLVED: route is shared with PocketBase core auth; baseline behavior after hook removal requires operator specification. Defect-16 is IMPL-MD because of this NEEDS-EXTERNAL dependency.

global_constants_required.HOOK_SRC_PATHS: All four keys must be set to valid file paths before --run
global_constants_required.HOOK_EXPECTED_SHA256: All four keys must be set to valid SHA-256 hashes before --run
global_constants_required.HOOK_PROBE_ROUTES: All four keys must be set; defect-28 enforces key-set exact match with HOOK_SRC_PATHS

defect_28_requirement: pb_check_package_completeness() verifies HOOK_PROBE_ROUTES keys exactly match HOOK_SRC_PATHS keys. Runs in --package-check mode.
unresolved_items: alias_intercept post-removal expected status (NEEDS-EXTERNAL — interceptor baseline)
nsu_hook_behavior_note: T-NSU-HOOK-BEHAVIOR is DEFERRED-MANDATORY. Hook source must define expected behavior for NSU requests routed through hook interceptors.
